summary: Spec fidelity/standards: all 25 scenarios (evidence.ci-run.01-11, gate.ci-run.01-14) are a one-line title over the placeholder step `Given a step`, with no When/Then (the same convention as the other 0.39-0.40 planner scenarios), so the Then is the title and I read each test against the title and the brief's acceptance. The bound case names of evidence.ci-run.06 and .07 (`..._is_ci_env_missing`, `..._is_ci_worktree_dirty`) still carry the pre-rename code names; a review pins case names, so renaming them after a signature stales that signature: rename before the reviews or keep them. Blast radius: none in behavior.
